name: deta
description: Deta CLI for managing Deta Micros

subcommands.name: login
subcommands.description: Trigger the login process for the Deta CLI

subcommands.name: version
subcommands.description: Print the Deta version

subcommands.name: upgrade
subcommands.description: Upgrade Deta CLI version

subcommands.name: projects
subcommands.description: List Deta projects

subcommands.name: new
subcommands.description: Create a new Deta Micro

options.name: -n
options.description: Create a micro with Node (node14.x) runtime

options.name: -p
options.description: Create a micro with Python (python 3.9) runtime

options.name: --name
options.description: Set the name of the new micro

options.name: --project
options.description: Set the project under which the micro is created

options.name: --runtime
options.description: Create a micro with a specified runtime

subcommands.name: deploy
subcommands.description: Deploy new code to a Deta Micro

subcommands.name: details
subcommands.description: Get detailed information about a specific Deta micro

subcommands.name: watch
subcommands.description: Auto-deploy locally saved changes in real time to your Deta micro

subcommands.name: auth
subcommands.description: Change auth settings for a Deta Micro

subcommands.name: disable
subcommands.description: Disable HTTP Auth for a Deta Micro

subcommands.name: enable
subcommands.description: Enable HTTP Auth for a Deta Micro

subcommands.name: create-api-key
subcommands.description: Create an API key for a Deta Micro

subcommands.name: delete-api-key
subcommands.description: Delete an API key for a Deta Micro

subcommands.name: pull
subcommands.description: Pull the latest deployed code of a Deta Micro to your local machine

options.name: -f
options.description: Force the overwrite of existing files

subcommands.name: clone
subcommands.description: Clone a Deta Micro

options.name: -n
options.description: The name of the micro to be cloned

options.name: -p
options.description: The name of the project with the micro to be cloned

subcommands.name: update
subcommands.description: Update a Deta Micro's name or environment variables

options.name: -n
options.description: The new name of the micro

options.name: -r
options.description: The new runtime of the micro

options.name: -e
options.description: The new env file of the micro

subcommands.description: Change the Visor settings for a Deta Micro

subcommands.name: open
subcommands.description: Open Micro's visor page in the browser

subcommands.name: enable
subcommands.description: Enable Visor for a Deta Micro

subcommands.name: disable
subcommands.description: Disable Visor for a Deta Micro

subcommands.name: run
subcommands.description: Run a Deta Micro from the CLI

subcommands.name: cron
subcommands.description: Change cron settings for a Deta Micro

subcommands.name: set
subcommands.description: Set Deta Micro to run on a schedule

subcommands.name: remove
subcommands.description: Remove a schedule from a Deta Micro
